_about: The REAL GET /api/runtime/status projection of two plugin setup gaps. `reports` are the setup_gaps.report() calls; `status` is what the server returns for them: each gap as a structured record in `setup_gaps[]` (#3395) AND as its legacy `Label: message` line in `warnings[]`. tests/test_console_handlers.py replays `reports` through the real handler and asserts `status` exactly; apps/web/e2e/warnings.spec.ts serves `status` to the console. #3421 shipped green against a hand-written mock that put gap objects inside `warnings[]` (a shape the server never sends), so real gaps rendered as plain alerts. Server shape changes -> the Python test fails here; update this file and the e2e re-runs against the new shape. The `repo` gap's open_url action is dropped by the host sanitizer, which is why it has no `actions`.
